Elements X and Y are in Group VII of the Periodic Table. X is a liquid while Y is a solid at room temperature.

Three predictions are made on elements X and Y.
1  Each atom of Y has more protons than each atom of X.
2  X has a darker colour than Y.
3  Y displaces X− ions from aqueous solutions of X.

Which of the above predictions made is true?

Four statements are made on elements P, Q, R and S.
1  P and S both conduct electricity.
2  P has a higher melting point than S.
3  Q and R will be formed as elements at the negative electrodes during electrolysis.

o: P could be sodium and S should be lithium.
Q could be chlorine and R could be oxygen.
Q could be copper and R could be silver.

Carbon monoxide is the main reducing agent used to form iron.
Silicon dioxide which is an impurity is removed by oxidation.
